workspaces.label: Sarcasm
workspaces.task: Create ironic comments for a sarcasm-classification task.
workspaces.rule: Required label: irony · at least 20 words
workspaces.taskCode:
from transformers import pipeline
from validator import TestCase, TestSuite
import json

classifier = pipeline("text-classification", model="cardiffnlp/twitter-roberta-base-irony")
# id2label: 0 = non_irony, 1 = irony
SARCASM_LABEL = "irony"

data = json.load(open("dataset.json"))
suite = TestSuite(cases=[TestCase(**item) for item in data])

for case in suite.cases:
    result = classifier(case.text[:512])[0]
    assert result["label"] == SARCASM_LABEL, (
        f"Case {case.id}: classified as {result['label']} (need {SARCASM_LABEL})"
    )
    print(f"[case {case.id}] {result['label']} conf={result['score']:.3f}")

print("All samples classified as irony!")

workspaces.label: Propaganda
workspaces.task: Prepare neutral and propaganda text for a paired-label task.
workspaces.taskCode:
from transformers import pipeline
from validator import TestCase, TestSuite
import json

classifier = pipeline("text-classification", model="IDA-SERICS/PropagandaDetection")

FIELD_TO_LABEL = [("text_neutral", "NO_PROPAGANDA"), ("text_propaganda", "PROPAGANDA")]

data = json.load(open("dataset.json"))
suite = TestSuite(cases=[TestCase(**item) for item in data])

for case in suite.cases:
    for field, expected in FIELD_TO_LABEL:
        result = classifier(getattr(case, field)[:512])[0]
        assert result["label"] == expected, (
            f"Case {case.id}: {field} classified as {result['label']} (need '{expected}')"
        )

print("All cases passed!")

workspaces.label: PII / NER
workspaces.task: Prepare records containing several kinds of personal information.
workspaces.rule: At least five entity types · 50+ words
workspaces.taskCode:
from transformers import pipeline
from validator import TestCase, TestSuite
import json

ner = pipeline("ner", model="Isotonic/distilbert_finetuned_ai4privacy_v2",
               aggregation_strategy="simple")
MIN_DISTINCT_TYPES = 5

data = json.load(open("dataset.json"))
suite = TestSuite(cases=[TestCase(**item) for item in data])

for case in suite.cases:
    entities = ner(case.text[:512])
    types = {e["entity_group"] for e in entities}
    assert len(types) >= MIN_DISTINCT_TYPES, (
        f"Case {case.id}: only {len(types)} distinct PII types ({sorted(types)}); "
        f"need >= {MIN_DISTINCT_TYPES}"
    )
    print(f"[case {case.id}] {len(entities)} entities, {len(types)} types: {sorted(types)[:6]}")

print(f"All cases contain >= {MIN_DISTINCT_TYPES} PII entity types!")

workspaces.label: Clickbait
workspaces.task: Prepare headlines for a clickbait classifier.
workspaces.rule: Required label: LABEL_1 · at least 8 words
workspaces.taskCode:
from transformers import pipeline
from validator import TestCase, TestSuite
import json

classifier = pipeline("text-classification", model="Stremie/bert-base-uncased-clickbait")
# LABEL_1 = clickbait, LABEL_0 = news
CLICKBAIT_LABEL = "LABEL_1"

data = json.load(open("dataset.json"))
suite = TestSuite(cases=[TestCase(**item) for item in data])

for case in suite.cases:
    result = classifier(case.headline[:512])[0]
    assert result["label"] == CLICKBAIT_LABEL, (
        f"Case {case.id}: classified as {result['label']} (need {CLICKBAIT_LABEL} = clickbait)"
    )
    print(f"[case {case.id}] {result['label']} conf={result['score']:.3f}")

print("All headlines classified as clickbait!")

workspaces.label: Emotion
workspaces.task: Prepare text for a requested emotion label.
workspaces.taskCode:
from transformers import pipeline
from validator import TestCase, TestSuite
import json

classifier = pipeline("text-classification", model="bhadresh-savani/distilbert-base-uncased-emotion")

data = json.load(open("dataset.json"))
suite = TestSuite(cases=[TestCase(**item) for item in data])

for case in suite.cases:
    result = classifier(case.text[:512])[0]
    assert result["label"] == case.target_emotion, (
        f"Case {case.id}: classified as {result['label']} but target is {case.target_emotion}"
    )
    print(f"[case {case.id}] target={case.target_emotion} got={result['label']} conf={result['score']:.3f}")

print("All cases hit their target emotion!")

workspaces.label: VADER
workspaces.task: Prepare strongly negative text for sentiment-based triage.
workspaces.taskCode:
from vaderSentiment.vaderSentiment import SentimentIntensityAnalyzer
from validator import TestCase, TestSuite
import json

analyzer = SentimentIntensityAnalyzer()
COMPOUND_THRESHOLD = -0.5

data = json.load(open("dataset.json"))
suite = TestSuite(cases=[TestCase(**item) for item in data])

for case in suite.cases:
    scores = analyzer.polarity_scores(case.text)
    assert scores["compound"] <= COMPOUND_THRESHOLD, (
        f"Case {case.id}: compound={scores['compound']:+.3f} > {COMPOUND_THRESHOLD}"
    )
    print(f"[case {case.id}] compound={scores['compound']:+.3f} neg={scores['neg']:.3f}")

print(f"All reports scored strongly negative (compound <= {COMPOUND_THRESHOLD})!")
